capabilities: View .totonio diagram files offline in a native tab with pan and zoom
Step through saved presentation frames with previous/next navigation and fit-to-pane
Embed static diagram previews in Markdown notes via a fenced code block
Filter shapes and connectors by existing document tags
Copy diagrams to the clipboard as JSON or PNG via right-click
disambiguation: Not a diagram editor; it only opens .totonio files read-only, and authoring happens in the separate Totonio web app.
extras: Donation-supported via Buy me a coffee; no account or payment required to view. Authoring diagrams requires the external web app with a manual file handoff (no save-back bridge). Bundled demo command works offline; supports only version 3 .totonio files and rejects legacy versions and .tatamio files.
motivation: The README's 'Why Totonio Here?' section explains the aim: explain a system one frame at a time and put the diagram beside the explanation in a design note.
problem: Obsidian cannot open .totonio diagram files, so users must leave the vault and use the external web app just to view or present diagrams saved alongside their notes.

relations.evidence: The Totonio web app is the authoring companion.

summary: Read-only offline viewer for .totonio diagram files: steps through saved presentation frames, filters by tags, and embeds static previews in Markdown.
